reason: A single terminal infrastructure failure without a final answer must not terminate the whole fixed-order experiment
retry_eligibility: Only a request with no final answer and explicit terminal turn status failed may receive one infrastructure retry
retry_uses: new ephemeral thread, identical locked prompt, gpt-6.1-sol/max, same wrapper and tool disables
single_item_retry_exhausted_policy: retain missing and continue if no non-retryable signal and consecutive-final-missing count is below 2
quota_note: 2% is a displayed safety margin, not a hard cap; an attempt may cross an integer boundary

save: JSON-RPC error code and sanitized message structure

order: pass1/index0..19, then pass2/index0..19; eligible infrastructure retry immediately after the failed attempt
